description: List all projects with issue counts per status. A sub-project has parent_id and path (its parents, from the top). with_money: true adds each project's money (budget total, received, to_receive in its currency, with its sub-projects, plus the sums of its number / money fields), the same numbers people see in the Budget / Received / To receive columns of the projects list.

with_money.description: true = also each project's budget, received and to receive (with its sub-projects)

name: list_projects
